AKHFASH:v2p552/r2.anchor: إنما المعنى "أو نصفه أو زد عليه" لأن ما يكون في معنى تكلم به العرب بغير: "أو"

TABRISI:73:8/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:8/r6.speaker: أبو السماك
TABRISI:73:8/r6.claim: Abū al-Sammāk's noncanonical reading has ḍamma on the mīm of qum, possibly by assimilation.
TABRISI:73:8/r6.anchor: وقراءة أبي السماك قم الليل بضم الميم

TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r1.claim: Al-layl is an adverbial of time, and qaliilan is an accusative exception meaning a small part of the night is left without prayer.
TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r1.anchor: الليل نصب على الظرف إلا قليلا نصب على الاستثناء

TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r8.claim: Standing through the night means praying at night.
TABRISI:73:1-10#2/r8.anchor: المعنى بالليل صل إلا قليلا من الليل

TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r1.speaker: الإمام علي بن أبي طالب
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r1.claim: One interpretation excepts a few nights of valid excuse, such as illness, overpowering sleep, or eye trouble.
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r1.anchor: ذكره الإمام علي بن أبي طالب ع

TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r2.claim: God left the Prophet free to choose the night hours, and he and a group of believers prayed for these amounts.
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r2.anchor: خير الله سبحانه نبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم في هذه الساعات القيام بالليل

TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r3.claim: The measure was difficult: some believers could not track how long they had prayed and stayed up all night for fear of falling short.
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r3.anchor: فكان الرجل منهم لا يدري كم صلى وكم بقي من الليل فكان يقوم الليل كله

TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r9.claim: The verses do not require abrogation; the better reading is that night prayer is strongly recommended, not obligatory.
TABRISI:73:1-10#3/r9.anchor: وليس في ظاهر الآيات ما يقتضي النسخ فالأولى أن يكون الكلام على ظاهره

TABRISI:73:20/r20.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:73:20/r20.speaker: أبو مسلم
TABRISI:73:20/r20.claim: Abū Muslim says the earlier command to stand means rising to recite the Qurʾan, not necessarily to pray.
TABRISI:73:20/r20.anchor: أراد القيام لقراءة القرآن لا غير

FARRA:v3p196#2/r2.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p196#2/r2.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p196#2/r2.claim: The phrase “half of it” means “or half of it,” continuing the alternatives for how much of the night to stand.
FARRA:v3p196#2/r2.anchor: يريد: الثلث الآخر، ثم قال: «نصفه» (3) . والمعنى: أو نصفه،

FARRA:v3p196#2/r3.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p196#2/r3.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p196#2/r3.claim: The allowance is to reduce the half toward a third or increase it toward two-thirds.
FARRA:v3p196#2/r3.anchor: «أو انقص منه قليلا» (3) من النصف إلى الثلث أو زد على النصف إلى الثلثين

FARRA:v3p196#2/r4.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p196#2/r4.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p196#2/r4.claim: This night prayer obligation preceded the five daily prayers and was abrogated when they were prescribed, as zakat superseded all charity and Ramadan superseded every fast.
FARRA:v3p196#2/r4.anchor: وكان هذا قبل أن تفرض الصلوات الخمس، فلما فرضت الصلاة نسخت هذا، كما نسخت الزكاة كل صدقة، وشهر رمضان كل صوم.

THALABI:v10p59/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p59/r1.speaker: مقاتل وابن كيسان
THALABI:v10p59/r1.claim: This command preceded the five daily prayers and was abrogated by their institution.
THALABI:v10p59/r1.anchor: وقال مقاتل وابن كيسان: كان هذا قبل أن يفرض الصلوات الخمس

THALABI:v10p59/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p59/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v10p59/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the first verses led believers to pray about as they do during Ramadan; a year passed between the sūra’s beginning and end.
THALABI:v10p59/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: لما نزل أول المزمل كانوا يقومون نحو من قيامهم

THALABI:v10p59/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p59/r3.speaker: عائشة
THALABI:v10p59/r3.claim: ʿĀʾisha says the Prophet feared congregational night prayer would become obligatory; it was imposed for eight months, then verse 20 relieved them and left only voluntary night prayer.
THALABI:v10p59/r3.anchor: وروى أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن عن عائشة، قالت:

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r1.claim: The command to stand at night means to pray.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: {قم الليل إلا قليلا (2)}، أي: للصلاة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says night prayer was obligatory for Muḥammad and the prophets before him, citing 17:79.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس: إن قيام الليل (3) كان فريضة على رسول الله -صلى الله عليه وسلم- وعلى النبيين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r3.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r3.claim: Al-Kalbī identifies the small amount excepted as the last third of the night.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r3.anchor: وقوله: {إلا قليلا} قال الكلبي: يعني بالقليل الثلث الأخير

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r4.speaker: ابن قتيبة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r4.claim: Ibn Qutayba explains: pray through the night except for a little sleep, namely one third of the night.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r4.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة: أي صل الليل إلا شيئا يسيرا (7) تنام فيه، وهو الثلث

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r6.claim: The exception is clarified by the options that follow: stand half the night, or reduce that half a little, or increase beyond it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r6.anchor: فالمعنى: قم نصف الليل إلا قليلا، وقوله: {إلا قليلا} هو قوله: {أو # انقص منه قليلا}

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r8.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r8.claim: The Prophet and a group of believers kept these measures; the burden was severe, some prayed the whole night for fear of missing the required amount, and the later verse eased and abrogated the requirement.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r8.anchor: وكان النبي -صلى الله عليه وسلم- وطائفة من المؤمنين معه [يقومون] (6) # علي هذه المقادير

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r9.claim: Al-Sammāk al-Ḥanafī reports Ibn ʿAbbās saying that after the opening verses came down, they prayed at night as long as you do in Ramadan until the end of the sūra was revealed; a year separated its opening and conclusion.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r9.anchor: ابن عباس (يقول) (¬4): لما أنزل الله أول المزمل كانوا يقومون (¬5) مثل (¬6) قيامكم في رمضان

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r11.speaker: عطاء الخراساني
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r11.claim: ʿAṭāʾ al-Khurāsānī says the night-prayer command was given in Mecca and was abrogated after the Prophet came to Medina by the remainder of the sūra.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p345/r11.anchor: وقال في رواية عطاء (الخراساني) (¬3) كان هذا بمكة، فلما قدم النبي -صلى الله عليه وسلم- المدينة نسختها

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p493#3/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p493#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p493#3/r1.claim: The night portioning passage, including half the night and increasing or decreasing it, is explained in Kitāb al-Mushkil.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p493#3/r1.anchor: وقوله: {إلا قليلا * نصفه أو انقص منه قليلا * أو زد عليه} ؛ مفسر في كتاب "المشكل" (3) .

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r2.claim: He is told to pray nearly all night and sleep for a small portion, identified here as one third.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r2.anchor: قم الليل إلا قليلا } أي: صل [كل] الليل إلا شيئا يسيرا تنام فيه، وهو الثلث

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r5.claim: The Muslims undertook these measures, found them difficult to keep, and sometimes prayed all night until their feet swelled.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r5.anchor: فلما نزلت هذه الآية أخذ المسلمون أنفسهم بالقيام على هذه المقادير، وشق ذلك عليهم؛ لأنهم لم يمكنهم أن يحفظوا هذه المقادير، وكانوا يقومون الليل كله انتفخت أقدامهم

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r6.claim: God lightened the burden at the end of the surah in 73:20, then the night vigil was abrogated by the five daily prayers in early Islam.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:73:1-4/r6.anchor: ثم خفف الله عنهم بآخر هذه السورة، وهو قوله: { إن ربك يعلم أنك تقوم... } الآية، ثم نسخ قيام الليل بالصلوات الخمس، وكان هذا في صدر الإسلام.

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p214/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p214/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p214/r2.claim: The command means pray through the night except a little for sleep, which he identifies as one third of the night.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p214/r2.anchor: أي: صل الليل إلا شيئا يسيرا منه تنام فيه وهو الثلث

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r5.claim: The Prophet is ordered to spend much of the night in worship; verses 3–4 allow the period to be half the night, somewhat less, or somewhat more.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r5.anchor: 2. âyette Hz. Peygamber’e gecenin büyük bir kısmını ibadetle geçirmesi emredilmiş; 3 ve 4. âyetlerde ibadet süresinin, gecenin yarısı kadar, daha azı yahut biraz fazlası olabileceği belirtilmiştir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r7.speaker: müfessirler
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r7.claim: Most commentaries say night prayer was obligatory for the Prophet and remained so after the five daily prayers became obligatory.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r7.anchor: Çoğunlukla tefsirlerde gece kalkıp namaz kılmanın Hz. Peygamber’e farz olduğu, beş vakit namaz farz kılındıktan sonra da bu ödevin aynen devam ettiği bildirilmektedir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r8.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r8.claim: The tahajjud obligation applied only to the Prophet; for his community, getting up at night for this prayer is sunnah.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:73:1/r8.anchor: Teheccüd adı verilen bu gece namazı yükümlülüğü Hz. Peygamber’e mahsus olup ümmetinin de geceleyin kalkıp bu namazı kılmaları sünnet kabul edilmiştir

BURHAN:v2p264/r8.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p264/r8.speaker: ثعلب
BURHAN:v2p264/r8.claim: Tha‘lab glosses “stand the night” as pray at night, since standing is only one part of the larger act of prayer.
BURHAN:v2p264/r8.anchor: وقوله ﴿ قم الليل ﴾ أي صل في الليل لأن القيام بعض الصلاة
